scientific_integrity: Analytical proof is supplied. Fixed-seed finite exact-rational checks are supporting diagnostics and are not universal certificates. Related earlier literature may contain an implicit equivalent; no independent audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected graphs with at least three vertices, positive edge-variation weights, real signals and symmetric two-endpoint exchange parameters in [0,1]. No theorem about arbitrary simultaneous mixers, nonlinear flows, or stochastic convergence rate. The exact-dated qualifying primary graph-total-variation anchor is the first arXiv version of Regression on a Graph (2009-11-10); earlier gossip publications are supporting background.
title: Local neighborhood imbalance governs weighted-variation stability of graph gossip
